acceptance.summary: BooleanLab now carries a versioned Cargo.lock, uses --locked dependency resolution in CI, pins workflow actions by immutable commit SHA, and records the explicit Rust 1.89 campaign toolchain.
verified_properties: Root Cargo.lock was generated with Cargo 1.89.0 and committed for the workspace dependency graph.
CI, BL-14 and BL-BE5 cargo operations use --locked where dependency resolution is required.
Workflow actions touched by the remediation are pinned to full commit SHAs.
The campaign toolchain is explicitly pinned to Rust 1.89.0, matching the declared MSRV campaign boundary.
The workflow no longer regenerates the lockfile; it requires the versioned lockfile to exist.
AGENTS.md, the mandatory off-main BooleanLab and ElasticXxx overlays, and PolyForm notices were read before merge; the experimental bench boundary is preserved.
limitations: The checked-in lockfile freezes the dependency graph for this source revision; intentional future updates require review and a new qualified lockfile.
The CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners and does not qualify other operating systems or hardware.

target_validation.note: The BL-BE5 workflow is pull-request scoped and therefore has no separate push run; its exact candidate run is retained above.

counting.rule: Count the technical PR exactly once; tracker commits are not counted.
